reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A5955 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A5955-Camera_ResetMatrix_5.cpp at sha256 4691a9334c8cb4b19ce26a67d01cdddd7156b803d6f5d767a9f0309929734e7a (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t Camera_ResetMatrix_5(long param_1);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_ResetMatrix_5
retail_function.summary: Five blocks 0x4A5955-0x4A597A: round-to-int of st0, compare/status-word flags in CL (0/1), if bit 6 of the status high byte set then multiply by g_543F00, round again and set CL=2; retn. No eax store.

candidate_function.summary: Five blocks 0x4A5955-0x4A597A: round-to-int of st0, compare/status-word flags in CL (0/1), if bit 6 of the status high byte set then multiply by g_543F00, round again and set CL=2; retn. No eax store.

divergences: st0 argument replaced by a stack long double.
Return register/value is the packed status word in EAX instead of CL.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0): the input is the x87 TOS, not a stack argument, and the retail return convention is CL/ECX (the only written register). The candidate int _test_whether_TOS_is_int(long double context) takes a stack long double and returns the packed status word in EAX.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 5 block(s)/5 edge(s) at 0x004A5955; radare2 recovers the identical 5 block(s)/5 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 5 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: None: the function is pure x87 and has no call sites.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: g_543F00 multiplier (the second scaling test); status bits 0x800 and bit 6 of the high byte; FCOMP flags.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: One global read at 0x00543F00; no writes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns with CL = 0/1/2 and never writes EAX; the candidate returns the status-word integer in EAX. The return register and value are not the same.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The whole function is x87 (fld/frndint/fcomp/fmul/fcompp); the candidate models it with roundl() on a stack long double, so the TOS entry and the CL return are not preserved.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0)" at 0x004A5955; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a5955 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A5955 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t Camera_ResetMatrix_5(long param_1);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
